note: eFV v5 metric atlas, development read (EW3-1 to EW3-3): nothing served moves, no cell by consensus-FV level, consensus FV a covariate only
spent_note: spent: the label window reaches a 2025+ debut cohort (R-VM, spent since the 10-08 confirmation); an owner-authorised short-horizon read (EW3-1) that selects nothing

position_groups.note: listing position dated inside the V = S + 1 window; generic OF reads as corner OF; the full population carries no position

declared.candidate_rule: incremental lift > 0, CI95 lower bound > 0, BH q <= 0.1 within (family, label)
declared.incremental: out-of-fold (5 player folds) AUC of logistic[season, consensus FV, metric] minus logistic[season, consensus FV]; WAR labels: within-season Spearman of ridge on the same columns (target within-season percentile)
declared.interval: player-clustered bootstrap, scores fixed, players resampled (E_cond); p from the bootstrap SD (normal)

reach3.what: reached MLB within 3 seasons after S

reach5.what: reached MLB within 5 seasons after S

w3.what: fWAR over the first three MLB seasons, debut within 3 seasons of S, 0 without

l6.what: six-season fWAR from the debut, debut within 3 seasons of S, 0 without

war_rate_h.what: fWAR per MLB season through 2026, 0 without a MLB line (horizon-censored)

hr_pct_rel_hit.what: home runs / PA, minus the level-season age line

iso_rel_hit.what: isolated power, minus the level-season age line

avg_rel_hit.what: batting average, minus the level-season age line

obp_rel_hit.what: on-base percentage, minus the level-season age line

slg_rel_hit.what: slugging, minus the level-season age line

ops_rel_hit.what: OPS, minus the level-season age line

babip_hit.what: batting average on balls in play

babip_rel_hit.what: batting average on balls in play, minus the level-season age line

woba_rel_hit.what: wOBA (fixed linear weights), minus the level-season age line

sb_rate_rel_hit.what: stolen bases / PA, minus the level-season age line

gb_pct_rel_hit.what: ground outs / (ground + air outs), minus the level-season age line

k_pct_rel_pit.what: strikeouts / BF, minus the level-season age line

bb_pct_rel_pit.what: walks / BF, minus the level-season age line

hr_pct_rel_pit.what: home runs / BF, minus the level-season age line

gb_pct_rel_pit.what: ground outs / (ground + air outs), minus the level-season age line

era_rel_pit.what: earned run average, minus the level-season age line

bf_per_g_rel_pit.what: batters faced per game, minus the level-season age line

gs_share_rel_pit.what: games started / games, minus the level-season age line

pbp_k_resid_hit.what: z(K rate) minus the pool slope times z(whiff rate)

pbp_k_resid_pit.what: z(K rate) minus the pool slope times z(whiff rate)

bb_hard_hit.what: hard-graded balls in play / balls in play

bb_pull_hit.what: pull-side balls in play / balls in play with a side

bb_oppo_hard_hit.what: hard opposite-side balls in play / opposite-side balls in play

bb_gb_pit.what: ground balls / balls in play against

bb_ld_pit.what: line drives / balls in play against

bb_fb_pit.what: fly balls / balls in play against

trk_gb_pit.what: ground-ball share of balls in play
